hypotheses.paper: the bubble sentence (l.873-875): B a causal bubble of J⁺(p), then B meets K⁺(p)
hypotheses.note: outside this target (the dispatch leaves it open). The existing Causal.bubble_need_not_meet_Kplus refutes the mechanism in general. It stays open under the hypotheses of prop:tarentin_fort_K.

findings: ETT.tex:872-877: the BTZ point does not show a second time that causal plainness cannot be dropped from prop:tarentin_fort_K. At E₀ the hypothesis that fails is 'p strongly tarentin in the past' (p ∉ Z⁻, rem:btz_pas_tarentin, l.1358-1361). E₀ is causally plain, absolutely minimal, tarentin, causal, Hausdorff and second countable, and K⁻(p) ≠ I⁻(p) at every BTZ point (Causal.E0.Zminus_cannot_be_dropped, Causal.E0.causallyPlain). So the BTZ point witnesses that the Z⁻ hypothesis of prop:tarentin_fort_K cannot be dropped. 'In degenerate form' is compatible with this. Placed right after 'Causal plainness cannot be dropped', though, the sentence reads as another instance of that. Suggested wording: '... at a BTZ point, which is not strongly tarentin in the past (Remark rem:btz_pas_tarentin), where I⁻(p) = ∅ while ...'. This rests on OQ-34.

ETT.tex:876-877 with l.1561: K⁻(p) = J⁻(p) ∖ {p} is prop:K_calcul (c), which assumes M causal; the remark does not say so. At E₀ (causal) nothing is omitted. If 'a BTZ point' is read in an arbitrary E≥0-manifold, as rem:pas_plat (l.294) and rem:btz_pas_tarentin (l.1358-1361) use the phrase, the hypothesis is missing from the equality. The paper states it itself at l.769: 'for a BTZ point p of a causal E≥0-manifold, p ∉ K⁻(p) = J⁻(p) ∖ {p}'. It is not needed for the separation: K⁻(p) ≠ I⁻(p) holds under BTZAxioms with no causality (Causal.Causality.BTZAxioms.Kminus_ne_Iminus). NOT FORMALIZED, a sketch only: in the non-causal quotient E₀/⟨τ ↦ τ+1⟩, J⁻(p) is the whole BTZ circle and lies in J⁻(u) for every u, so p ∈ K⁻(p) and the equality fails while I⁻(p) = ∅ still holds. Suggested wording: '... at a BTZ point of a causal E≥0-manifold' or '... of E₀'.
questions: OQ-34 (open, not decided here): the BTZ sentence is proved at Causal.E0 in the port's reading (flat extreme-BTZ metric through D, DEC-33's causal curves). Under the printed metric (l.1330) the singular line is timelike and I⁻(p) = ∅ fails. Even with OQ-34 ruled the row stays partial, because the bubble sentence (l.873-875) is open.

'A BTZ point' (l.876): read as a point of sing(E₀) (defi:causal_E0, l.1346-1347). The anchors are the model's (Causal.E0.K_neq_I_btz, assembled with the first sentence in Causal.E0.K_neq_I). The E≥0-manifold reading is Causal.Causality.BTZAxioms.K_neq_I, with M causal (see the second finding).
'The same separation' (l.875): read as K⁻(p) ≠ I⁻(p) only, not as a second witness that plainness cannot be dropped. Under the latter reading the sentence is not supported at E₀ (first finding).

kb_proposals: E₀ is causally plain (Causal.E0.causallyPlain). The model-free criterion is Causality.causallyPlain_of_locZ: push-up, Z⁺ in every open set, and Z⁻ in every open set off a set with empty interior give causal plainness. Its corollary SingularFlatAxioms.causallyPlain says a strongly causal SFA spacetime is causally plain. Check these before assuming plainness fails on E≥0-manifolds (OQ-16, rem:pas_plat).
At a BTZ point under BTZAxioms, K⁻(p) ≠ I⁻(p) needs no causality (BTZAxioms.Kminus_ne_Iminus). Only the equality K⁻(p) = J⁻(p) ∖ {p} needs IsCausal (Kminus_eq_Jminus_diff).

New names live in Causal.E0 and Causal.Causality. Causal.E0.relation_not_assumed_reflexive and Causal.E0.K_neq_I are distinct from the existing Causal.relation_not_assumed_reflexive, and nothing collides in the environment. Beyond the two labels, three things for the curation. (1) OQ-16 asks whether E≥0-manifolds are meant to be causally plain. E₀ is causally plain, and every strongly causal SingularFlatAxioms spacetime is. This is evidence for OQ-16, not a ruling. (2) prop:K_calcul's (a) and (b) hold at E₀ by the paper's own route through prop:tarentin_fort_K and plainness (Causal.E0.K_calcul_paper), not only through push-up. (3) The recorded rem:pas_plat finding says 'nothing in the paper shows an E≥0-manifold is not causally plain'. At E₀ the converse is now proved, which strengthens the case against 'it fails in the two families' (l.290) for singularities. The rows of rem:relation_not_assumed_reflexive and rem:K_neq_I name T-ett-port-e0 / 'the BTZ model E_0' as blocked_on; that dependency is met, and the remaining block is OQ-34.
